other_conditions: The applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh
The applicant must be a building/construction worker registered with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The worker must have completed at least 90 days of construction work in the last 12 months
The worker must have at least two months of subscription with the Board
The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application
benefits_summary: A cash assistance of ₹25,000 per registered female worker at the time of delivery or birth of a child.
documents_required: Wage slip or appointment letter from employer
Certificate from a local authority (councilor, executive officer, or Panchayat Secretary)
